name: Find the Icon of The Shadowhold
description: The heroes must explore the dungeon to find the lost Icon of The Shadowhold and escape with their lives.
victoryConditions: Hero possesses Icon of The Shadowhold
defeatConditions: Any hero at 0 HP with no surges
specialRules: Draw from Encounter deck every exploration phase

name: Reset the Beacon
description: Light the four torches in the central chamber to reveal the secret exit.
